media.caption: A vessel permits close observation of form and surface. Excavated tools, debris and working spaces can support different claims about making. Bernier distinguishes a partly excavated fineware workshop from a utilitarian production area identified through surface evidence. These categories are not the known find context of either selected Met vessel; the drawing copies no source plan or ancient motif.
